title: He was appointed a Director on 7th August 2013, as the alternate to the Principal
columns:
Richard L. Kimanthi, Director (63)
Joined the Board of Directors in 1994. He is a businessman and has served in various
leadership positions in the co-operative movement for a considerable period.He holds a
Diploma in Co-operative Management. He is a Director of Co-op Holdings Co-operative
Society Limited.
